notes: Read SKILL.md and references/details.md in full. WCAG 2.2 audit guidance: conformance levels, POUR principles, a checklist organized by success-criterion number and name with the skill's own check items, axe-core/Playwright automation, and remediation patterns for labels, contrast, and keyboard support.

The only commands are optional CLI audits (references/details.md:394-399): npx @axe-core/cli and npx pa11y, which download and run npm packages, and lighthouse, all pointed at a placeholder https://example.com. Medium because npx fetches and executes unpinned packages; acceptable because these are well-known accessibility scanners run against the user's own site, with no credentials or state changes.

The HTML comments flagged by signals (e.g. references/details.md:21, :25, :338, :406-416) are '<!-- Good -->'/'<!-- Bad -->' style labels inside HTML code samples and carry no hidden instructions. Success-criterion numbers and titles (e.g. '1.4.3 Contrast (Minimum)') are referenced, but the checklist items are paraphrased, not W3C normative text.
